methodology.ourGenerator: unchanged production Auto64 then existing MaxColors subset at equal budget
methodology.strengths: native default PixelLab5/10 and Colorfetti50/100; maxima10/100; these are NOT calibrated equivalents
methodology.blockTone: 4x4 and8x8 linear-light averages then Oklab; excludes blocks containing any below-cut source/output pixel
methodology.fileSizes: native PNGs include codec differences; common RGBA PNG encoder normalizes fully transparent RGB to zero and isolates color-pattern compressibility only when alpha and geometry agree; otherwise it includes alpha-contract differences

cases.targetImageAlphaSemantics: service target contains hidden RGB; comparison supplies every RGB explicitly to isolate matching; Colorfetti image import skips fully transparent colors

cases.oursUnavailable: Actual Auto pipeline has no visible colors at cut128 and disables color-dependent exports; no output fabricated.
